transcript.en: Good morning. Total Insurance.
Judy speaking, how may I help you?
I recently shipped my belongings from overseas back here to Australia and I took out insurance with your company.
transcript.zh: 我最近从海外运来一些东西到澳大利亚，我上的是你们公司的保险。

transcript.en: Some items were damaged during the move so I need to make a claim.
transcript.zh: 有些物品在运送过程中损坏了，所以我需要提出索赔。

transcript.en: What do I have to do?
Okay, well first I need to get a few details about this.
transcript.zh: 好的，首先我需要了解一些详情。

transcript.en: Can you give me your name please?
Yes. It's Michael Alexander.
transcript.zh: 好的，我叫迈克尔·亚历山大。

transcript.en: Okay.
And your address please?
My old address or my current one?
transcript.zh: 我过去的地址还是现在的地址？

transcript.en: Your current one.
It's 24 Manly Street, Milperra near Sydney.
transcript.zh: 米尔佩拉，曼利街24号，悉尼附近。

transcript.en: What was the suburb, sorry?
Milperra.
M-l-L-P-E-R-R-A.
Right.
Now, who was the shipping agent, Mr. Alexander?
transcript.zh: 亚历山大先生，运货代理商是谁？

transcript.en: You mean the company we used?
Yes, the company who packed everything up at the point of origin.
transcript.zh: 是的，从出发地负责打包的公司，

transcript.en: Oh, it was …er... First Class Movers.
Okay ... where were the goods shipped from?
transcript.zh: 好的，这些东西从哪运来的？

transcript.en: China, but the ship came via Singapore and was there for about a week.
transcript.zh: 中国，但是船经由新加坡并在那里停留了一周左右。

transcript.en: Don't worry, all of that information will be in the documentation.
transcript.zh: 别担心，所有信息都将记录在文件中。

transcript.en: Now, the dates.
Do you know when the ship arrived?
transcript.zh: 你知道船在什么时候抵达的吗？

transcript.en: It left on the 11th of October and got to Sydney on the 28th of November.
transcript.zh: 它在10月11日起航，在11月28日抵达悉尼。

transcript.en: Okay.
I need one more thing. There's a reference number.
transcript.zh: 还有一件事，我需要参考编号。

transcript.en: It should be in the top right-hand-corner of the pink form they gave you.
transcript.zh: 它在他们给你的一个粉色表格中的右上角。

transcript.en: Let me have a look.
I have so many papers.
Yes, here it is.
It's 601 ACK.
Thanks.
I need to take down a few details of the actual damage over the phone before you put in a full report.
transcript.zh: 在你填写完整的报告之前，我需要在电话中记下实际损毁的细节。

transcript.en: Can you tell me how many items were damaged and what the damage was?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我有多少物品损坏了，而且损坏的物品是什么吗？

transcript.en: Yes, well four things actually.
transcript.zh: 好的，事实上有四个东西。

transcript.en: I'll start with the big things.
My TV first of all.
It's a large one...very expensive.
Our insurance doesn't cover electrical problems.
transcript.zh: 我们的保险不包括电子故障

transcript.en: It isn't an electrical problem.
The screen has a huge crack in it so it's unusable.
transcript.zh: 屏幕上有一个巨大的裂口，所以已经没法用了。

transcript.en: I see.
Any idea of the price to repair it?
No.
Well, I don't think it can be repaired.
It will need a new one.
Okay.
I'll make a note of that and we'll see what we can do.
transcript.zh: 我记下来了，我们会看看该怎么办，

transcript.en: Now, what was the second item?
transcript.zh: 现在，第二个物品是什么？

transcript.en: The cabinet from the bathroom was damaged as well.
It's a lovely cabinet; we use it to keep our towels in.
transcript.zh: 这是一个很好的橱柜，我们用它来存放毛巾。

transcript.en: And what is the extent of the damage?
Well, the back and the sides seem okay but the door has a huge hole in it.
transcript.zh: 后面和两侧还可以，但是门上有一个巨大的洞。

transcript.en: It can't be repaired.
I'm really not very happy about it.
And how much do you think it will cost to replace it?
transcript.zh: 你觉得换掉它要花多少钱？

transcript.en: Well, when I bought it last year I paid $125 for it.
transcript.zh: 我去年买的时候花了125美金。

transcript.en: But the one I've seen here in Sydney is a bit more expensive, it's $140.
transcript.zh: 但是我在悉尼见过一个要贵一点，需要140美金。

transcript.en: Right, and what was the third item?
My dining room table.
It's a lovely table from Indonesia.
transcript.zh: 这是一张好看的印尼餐桌。

transcript.en: It must have been very hot inside the container because one leg has completely split down the middle.
transcript.zh: 集装箱里一定很热，因为一个桌腿已经完全从中间折断了。

transcript.en: The top and the other three look okay thank goodness.
transcript.zh: 谢天谢地，桌面和其他三条腿没事。

transcript.en: Any idea of the price to repair it?
transcript.zh: 你知道修理它的价格吗

transcript.en: Well, I had an estimate done on this actually because it is a very special table to us.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我做过估价，因为这个对我们来说很特别。

transcript.en: They quoted us $200, which is really pricey so I hope the insurance will cover the total cost.
transcript.zh: 他们给出的报价是200美金，价格很高，所以我希望保险能够全额理赔。

transcript.en: I'm sure that will be fine.
What was the last item, Mr. Alexander?
transcript.zh: 亚历山大先生，最后一件是什么？

transcript.en: Well, we have a lovely set of china plates and dishes, you know, with matching cups, saucers, the lot.
transcript.zh: 我们有一套精美的瓷盘与茶杯、茶碟等搭配。

transcript.en: They were all in the one box which must have got dropped because some plates were broken - six actually.
transcript.zh: 它们都在一个箱子里，但是肯定是摔了，因为一些盘子都碎了，事实上是碎了6个。

transcript.en: And can you tell me the replacement value of these?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我它们的价格吗

transcript.en: Well, it's hard to say because they were part of a set but they can be up to $10 each as it's such a good set.
transcript.zh: 很难说，因为它们属于一套，但是可能高到10美金一个，因为这是一套很好的瓷盘。

transcript.en: Okay, so that would be around $60 altogether?
transcript.zh: 好的，所以一共是大约60美金？

transcript.en: Yes, that's right.
And is that all of the items?
Yes.
So what do I have to do now?
